items.title: Does a Code-Tuned Embedding Model Pay Off? papr-embed-code-1 in Qdrant
items.summary: If you search code, you’ve probably asked this: is a code-specific embedding model worth it, or is a strong general one good enough?Papr’s papr-embed-code-1 is a good test case. It’s Qwen3-Embedding trained further on code retrieval, with open weights in two sizes: 0.6B and 4B. Papr reports top scores on CoIR, a code retrieval benchmark. But it trained on most of CoIR’s training data, and its model card says so. Papr also reports the 4B at #1 on MTEB’s two held-out code leaderboards, RTEB (Code) and CodeRAG.
